summary: The transcript resolved every repository-unknown behavior needed for implementation and the final contract faithfully preserves the audited list semantics, text behavior, errors, exit codes, storage guarantees, and dependency constraint. It also recalls all five private owner decisions: bare array and empty array behavior, exact compact newline-terminated formatting and key order, list-local flag scope, and standards-compliant escaping. No material decisions remain open, and no unsupported requirements were introduced.
